summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py gets an EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) with the eleven members and comments. botocore/args.py gets the EPRBuiltins import, the STS predicate now accepts a None endpoint config, and compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults is added to ClientArgsCreator. tests/unit/test_args.py gets TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioural criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 59 passed; test_client, test_regions, test_args, test_endpoint, test_utils 722 passed; full tests/unit run exited 0, though its summary line was not captured. Choices: SDK::Endpoint is always a key, set to None when absent; FIPS and DualStack use the bridge's private lookup methods; the resolver's uses_builtin_data attribute drives the custom-data check. One pre-existing line in args.py (around line 315) exceeds 79 columns and was left unchanged. Nothing is committed.
